title: 〜代わりに / 〜かわりに
meaning: Instead of… / in place of… / in exchange for…
simpleExplanation: 〜代わりに has two related uses. (1) Substitution: 部長の代わりに私が出席します = I will attend in place of the manager. (2) Trade-off: 駅に近い代わりに家賃が高い = it's close to the station, but in exchange the rent is high. In both, one thing is exchanged for another.
whenUsed: Everyday and formal. Substitution use is very common in offices; trade-off use in descriptions of pros and cons.
formation: な-adjective + な + 代わりに
Formal substitute: Noun + に代わって

diagram.title: Two uses of 代わりに

rows.label: substitution
cells: 部長の代わりに出席する

rows.label: compensation

examples.ja: 部長の代わりに、私が会議に出席します。
examples.reading: ぶちょうのかわりに、わたしがかいぎにしゅっせきします。
examples.en: I will attend the meeting in place of the department manager.
examples.note: Substitution: attending on behalf of someone.

examples.ja: 車で行く代わりに、自転車で行った。
examples.reading: くるまでいくかわりに、じてんしゃでいった。
examples.en: Instead of going by car, I went by bicycle.
examples.note: Substitution of an action: bicycle instead of car.

examples.ja: このアパートは駅に近い代わりに、家賃が高い。
examples.reading: このアパートはえきにちかいかわりに、やちんがたかい。
examples.en: This apartment is near the station, but in exchange the rent is high.
examples.note: Trade-off: an advantage paired with a disadvantage.

examples.ja: 今日は手伝ってあげる代わりに、来週は君が手伝ってね。
examples.reading: きょうはてつだってあげるかわりに、らいしゅうはきみがてつだってね。
examples.en: I'll help you today; in return, you help me next week.

examples.ja: この薬はよく効く代わりに、眠くなるという副作用がある。
examples.reading: このくすりはよくきくかわりに、ねむくなるというふくさようがある。
examples.en: This medicine works well, but in exchange it has the side effect of making you sleepy.

similarGrammar.difference: Formal "on behalf of", only for substitution of people or things.
Trade-off only: "on the other hand". Cannot mean "instead of".
"Without doing / instead of doing" as a manner, without the idea of exchange.

commonMistakes.why: Nouns need の before 代わりに.

commonMistakes.wrong: 駅に近いの代わりに家賃が高い。
commonMistakes.right: 駅に近い代わりに家賃が高い。
commonMistakes.why: Adjectives and verbs attach directly; の is only for nouns.

commonMistakes.wrong: コーヒーの代わりに紅茶を飲みませんか。(intended: instead of coffee, how about tea?)
commonMistakes.right: コーヒーの代わりに紅茶はいかがですか。
commonMistakes.why: Grammatical, but 代わりに + an invitation sounds like a demand; rephrase as an offer.

usageNotes: For sense (2), 〜反面 is a close relative; 代わりに implies a trade-off. 〜に代わって is the formal substitute form ("on behalf of").
Sentence-initial その代わり(に) = "in exchange / but on the other hand".
jlptTips: If someone or something replaces another, choose 代わりに; if the sentence lists a plus and a minus, 代わりに is also correct (trade-off).
The noun connection is の代わりに; verbs and adjectives attach directly. Check the option's connector.
Distractors: に比べて, に加えて, にしては. Only 代わりに carries the idea of exchange.
